helper_contract.request_n: External per-domain epoch reset upstream of local conditioners/forwarding. Never substitute final local rn for request.
helper_contract.witness: Async clears on request assertion even if clock stops. After request release, must sample all supplied actual local states LOW at a consumer edge. Missed reset remains unacknowledged until a valid epoch reset.
helper_contract.release: ACK requires witness, all final local states HIGH, and actual local online/rendezvous. ack_q rises at a later consumer edge; output also gates by actual local release/live so a real local reset/online loss drops it.
helper_contract.initialization_edge: At a witnessed LOW edge, existing consumers execute their real reset initialization. Registering rn_r/rn_q HIGH and sampling their old LOW initializes consumer state that edge; ACK rises on a later edge. No ACK state gates datapath.
